clauses.title: LRFD Basic Load Combinations (Strength Design)
clauses.summary: Factored ultimate load combinations for dead (D), live (L), roof live/snow (Lr/S), wind (W), and seismic (E) loads.
clauses.details: Primary governing LRFD combinations: (1) 1.4D; (2) 1.2D + 1.6L + 0.5(Lr or S); (3) 1.2D + 1.6(Lr or S) + (L or 0.5W); (4) 1.2D + 1.0W + L + 0.5(Lr or S); (5) 1.2D + 1.0E + L + 0.2S; (6) 0.9D + 1.0W; (7) 0.9D + 1.0E. Always verify uplift/overturning with 0.9D.

clauses.title: Serviceability Deflection Limits for Beams & Floors
clauses.summary: Maximum allowable elastic deflections under live load (L/360 for floors) and total load (L/240).
clauses.details: Floor members: Live load deflection <= L/360; Dead+Live <= L/240. Roof members supporting plaster ceilings: Live <= L/360, Total <= L/240; non-plaster ceilings: Live <= L/240, Total <= L/180. Exterior walls with brittle finishes: Wind <= L/240 (or L/360 for masonry veneer).

clauses.title: Structural Steel Flexure, Shear & Column Buckling
clauses.summary: Yielding plastic moment Mn = Fy*Zx (phi_b=0.90), Euler/inelastic column buckling (phi_c=0.90), and web shear Vn = 0.6*Fy*Aw*Cv1.
clauses.details: For laterally braced compact doubly symmetric I-shapes, design flexural strength phi_b*Mn = 0.90 * Fy * Zx (or conservatively 0.90 * Fy * Sx for elastic check). For compression members, compute KL/r and Fe = pi^2*E / (KL/r)^2; if KL/r <= 4.71*sqrt(E/Fy), Fcr = (0.658^(Fy/Fe))*Fy else Fcr = 0.877*Fe.
clauses.formula: phi*Mn = 0.90 * Fy * Zx; Fe = pi^2 * E / (KL/r)^2

clauses.title: Minimum Concrete Cover for Reinforcement
clauses.summary: Minimum clear concrete cover to protect rebar from corrosion and fire: 3 in cast against earth, 2 in exposed to weather (#6-#18), 0.75 in interior slabs.
clauses.details: Cast against and permanently in contact with ground: 75 mm (3 in). Exposed to weather or earth (#6 through #18 bars): 50 mm (2 in); #5 and smaller: 38 mm (1.5 in). Not exposed to weather or earth — slabs/walls: 20 mm (0.75 in); beams/columns: 40 mm (1.5 in).

clauses.title: Ultimate Limit State (ULS) Fundamental Load Combination
clauses.summary: European partial factor ULS design: 1.35*Gk + 1.50*Qk,1 + sum(1.50*psi_0*Qk,i).
clauses.details: Permanent actions Gk use partial factor gamma_G = 1.35 (unfavourable) or 1.00 (favourable). Leading variable action Qk,1 uses gamma_Q = 1.50. Accompanying variable actions apply combination factor psi_0 (typically 0.7 for offices, 0.6 for wind, 0.5 for snow).

clauses.title: California High-Seismic Drift & Ductility Detailing
clauses.summary: Story drift limits (0.020*hsx for Risk Cat II), non-structural MEP seismic bracing, and special moment/braced frame detailing.
clauses.details: In California SDC D/E/F, structural frames must satisfy story drift <= 0.020*h_sx (Risk Cat I/II) or 0.015*h_sx (Risk Cat III) or 0.010*h_sx (Risk Cat IV). Mechanical/electrical equipment >400 lb or piping/ducts above exemptions require seismic lateral & longitudinal sway bracing per ASCE 7 Ch. 13.

clauses.title: High-Velocity Hurricane Zone Wind Pressure & Impact Glazing
clauses.summary: Ultimate wind speeds >= 175 mph (Miami-Dade/Broward) with mandatory wind-borne debris impact protection.
clauses.details: Structures in Florida HVHZ must design C&C and MWFRS for V_ult >= 175 mph (Risk Cat II) and protect all glazed openings against large-missile impact or design as partially enclosed with elevated internal pressure coefficient GCpi = +/-0.55.
clauses.formula: qz = 0.00256 * Kz * Kzt * Kd * Ke * V^2 (psf, V in mph)

clauses.title: Excavation Sloping, Benching & Shoring Requirements
clauses.summary: Protective systems required for excavations >= 5 ft (1.52 m) deep; max allowable slopes: Type A 0.75H:1V (53°), Type B 1H:1V (45°), Type C 1.5H:1V (34°).
clauses.details: Excavations >= 5 ft require shoring, shielding, or sloping unless in stable rock (90°). Excavations > 20 ft (6.1 m) MUST be designed by a registered professional engineer. Spoil piles must be kept >= 2 ft (0.61 m) from trench edge.
clauses.formula: slope_H_to_V: Rock=0, TypeA=0.75, TypeB=1.0, TypeC=1.5; PE_required if depth > 6.1 m

clauses.title: Shallow Foundation Ultimate & Allowable Bearing Capacity
clauses.summary: Ultimate bearing q_ult = c*Nc + q*Nq + 0.5*gamma*B*Ngamma with typical Factor of Safety FS >= 3.0.
clauses.details: Verify both bearing capacity (q_applied <= q_ult / FS, where FS >= 3.0 for dead+live) and serviceability settlement (typically <= 25 mm total, <= 19 mm differential for isolated footings). Adjust gamma to submerged unit weight gamma' below groundwater table.

clauses.title: Stormwater Runoff & Gravity Pipe/Channel Sizing
clauses.summary: Peak runoff Q = C*i*A; gravity flow Q = (1/n)*A*R^(2/3)*S^(1/2) with self-cleansing velocity >= 0.6 m/s (2 ft/s).
clauses.details: Storm sewer minimum velocity should be >= 0.6–0.9 m/s (2–3 ft/s) to prevent sediment deposition and <= 3.0–4.5 m/s (10–15 ft/s) to prevent pipe abrasion. Minimum cover over storm pipes under traffic is typically >= 0.6–0.9 m (2–3 ft) or below frost line.
clauses.formula: Q_manning = (1/n) * A * R^(2/3) * S^(1/2); Q_rational = C * i * A

clauses.title: Accessible Ramp Slope, Cross-Slope & Landings
clauses.summary: Maximum running slope 1:12 (8.33%), max cross-slope 1:48 (2.08%), max rise 30 in (760 mm) per run.
clauses.details: Accessible site routes without handrails max slope is 1:20 (5.0%). Ramps > 1:20 up to 1:12 require 36 in (915 mm) minimum clear width between handrails and level 60x60 in (1525 mm) landings every 30 in of vertical rise.

clauses.title: Continuous Load 125% Sizing & Voltage Drop Recommendations
clauses.summary: Size overcurrent devices and conductors for 125% of continuous loads (>=3 hrs) + 100% non-continuous; keep voltage drop <= 3% branch / <= 5% total.
clauses.details: Feeder and branch-circuit conductors must have ampacity >= 1.25 * I_continuous + 1.00 * I_noncontinuous after ambient temperature (Table 310.15(B)(1)) and conduit bundling (>3 current-carrying conductors, Table 310.15(C)(1)) derating. Informational Note: keep branch voltage drop <= 3% and combined feeder + branch <= 5%.

clauses.title: Conduit & Tubing Percentage Fill Limits
clauses.summary: Maximum cross-sectional fill: 53% for 1 conductor, 31% for 2 conductors, 40% for 3 or more conductors.
clauses.details: To prevent thermal buildup and cable pulling damage (jamming), total conductor cross-sectional area (including insulation) must not exceed 53% (1 wire), 31% (2 wires), or 40% (3+ wires) of conduit internal area. Nipples <= 24 in (600 mm) permit up to 60% fill.

clauses.title: Solar PV / ESS Load-Side Interconnection 120% Busbar Rule
clauses.summary: Main breaker rating + 125% of inverter max output current must not exceed 120% of panelboard busbar rating when backfed at opposite end.
clauses.details: For load-side solar PV/battery interconnections where the backfed breaker is located at the opposite end of the busbar from the main supply breaker: (I_main_ocpd + I_pv_ocpd) <= 1.20 * I_busbar, where I_pv_ocpd >= 1.25 * I_inverter_max. Alternative: supply-side tap (705.11) or sum-of-breakers <= 100% busbar.

clauses.title: International Low-Voltage Cable Sizing & Voltage Drop
clauses.summary: IEC voltage drop guidelines: 3% lighting / 5% other uses from public LV supply (6%/8% from private transformer).
clauses.details: Metric conductor cross-sections (1.5, 2.5, 4, 6, 10, 16, 25, 35, 50, 70, 95, 120 mm^2) selected by installation method (A1–G) and ambient/grouping correction factors.

clauses.title: Outdoor Air Ventilation Rates for Acceptable IAQ
clauses.summary: Breathing zone outdoor airflow Vbz = Rp*Pz + Ra*Az (e.g., Office: 5 CFM/person + 0.06 CFM/ft^2).
clauses.details: Combine occupant component (Rp * Pz) and building floor-area component (Ra * Az), then divide by zone air distribution effectiveness Ez (1.0 for ceiling cool supply, 0.8 for ceiling warm supply). Typical offices: Rp=5 CFM/p (2.5 L/s/p), Ra=0.06 CFM/ft^2 (0.3 L/s/m^2). Classrooms: Rp=10 CFM/p, Ra=0.12 CFM/ft^2.
clauses.formula: Vbz = Rp*Pz + Ra*Az; Voz = Vbz / Ez

clauses.title: Equal-Friction HVAC Duct Sizing & Velocity Noise Limits
clauses.summary: Target friction rate 0.8–1.0 Pa/m (0.08–0.10 in.wg/100 ft); keep branch velocity <= 4–5 m/s and main trunk <= 7.5–10 m/s to limit noise.
clauses.details: Convert rectangular ducts (a x b) to Huebscher equivalent circular diameter: De = 1.30 * (a*b)^0.625 / (a+b)^0.25. Maintain aspect ratio a/b <= 4:1 to minimize friction and sheet-metal cost. Keep minimum 50 mm clearance from structural steel and electrical cable trays.

clauses.title: Closed-Conduit Pipe Head Loss & Velocity Limits
clauses.summary: Head loss hf = f*(L/D)*(v^2/2g); hydronic chilled/hot water pipe velocity typically 0.6–2.4 m/s (2–8 ft/s) to balance noise, erosion, and pumping power.
clauses.details: Compute Reynolds number Re = rho*v*D/mu. For laminar flow (Re < 2300), f = 64/Re. For turbulent flow, Swamee-Jain explicitly approximates Colebrook-White within 1%. Keep copper domestic hot water velocity <= 1.5 m/s (5 ft/s) to prevent erosion-corrosion.
clauses.formula: hf = f * (L/D) * (v^2 / (2*g)); Re = rho * v * D / mu

clauses.title: Sanitary Drainage Horizontal Pipe Minimum Slope
clauses.summary: Minimum horizontal drainage slope: 2% (1/4 in/ft) for pipes <= 2.5 in, 1% (1/8 in/ft) for 3–6 in, 0.5% (1/16 in/ft) for >= 8 in.
clauses.details: Proper gravity slope maintains scouring velocity (~0.6 m/s) so solids travel with liquid rather than stranding. Avoid excessive slope on small lines without venting checks.

clauses.title: 3D Printing (FDM / SLS) Wall Thickness, Overhang & Clearance Rules
clauses.summary: Watertight manifold mesh required; FDM min wall >= 0.8–1.2 mm (2-3 perimeters), overhang <= 45° without supports, moving-part clearance >= 0.3–0.4 mm.
clauses.details: Before slicing to 3MF/STL: verify zero boundary edges, zero non-manifold edges, positive outward normals. For FDM (0.4 mm nozzle): min feature 0.8 mm, snap-fit clearance 0.2 mm, print-in-place hinge clearance 0.35–0.5 mm. For SLS PA12: min wall 0.8 mm, powder escape holes >= 4 mm.
clauses.formula: wall >= 2 * nozzle_d; clearance_moving >= 0.35 mm; overhang <= 45 deg

clauses.title: Spacecraft / Pressurized Habitat Structural Factors of Safety & Radiation Shielding
clauses.summary: Metallic flight structures: Yield FS >= 1.1–1.25, Ultimate FS >= 1.4–1.5; Pressurized crew habitats: Ultimate FS >= 2.0 on proof/burst; Lunar/Mars GCR/SPE shielding target >= 20–50 g/cm^2 (up to 400 g/cm^2 regolith vaults).
clauses.details: For human-rated planetary pressurized habitats, combine internal pressure loads (typically 56–101 kPa) with planetary gravity regolith overburden (g_moon = 1.62 m/s^2, g_mars = 3.72 m/s^2) and extreme radiative thermal cycling (100–400 K on Moon). Minimum 20 g/cm^2 hydrogen-rich shielding (water/ice/polyethylene) protects against solar particle events (SPE); 2–3 m sintered lunar regolith (~450–700 g/cm^2) provides long-term GCR protection.
clauses.formula: FS_yield >= 1.25; FS_ult_metallic >= 1.4; FS_pressure_habitat >= 2.0; areal_density = rho * thickness
